idea-plugin.name: LogParser Pro
idea-plugin.description:
LogParser Pro — Advanced Log Analysis in Your IDE

Stop switching between your IDE and log viewers. LogParser Pro brings professional log analysis directly into your JetBrains IDE with colour-coded levels, filtering, pattern matching, correlation tracking, and ML-powered anomaly detection.

Free Features

  • Colour-Coded Log Levels — ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE highlighted for instant visibility
  • Dedicated Log Editor — Custom editor tab for .log, .txt, and .out files
  • Log Level Filtering — Filter entries by severity with a single click
  • Keyword Search — Full-text search across log entries
  • Pattern Library — Auto-detection of Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and Java formats
  • Stack Trace Folding — Collapse exception stack traces for readability
  • Regex Pattern Extraction — Generate regex patterns from selected text

Premium Features (30-day free trial)

  • Correlation ID Tracking — Follow request flows across microservices
  • Advanced Search — Regex, fuzzy, and proximity search with log indexing
  • ML Anomaly Detection — Statistical pattern discovery and anomaly scoring
  • Log Indexing — Fast indexed search across large log files
  • ML Log Classification — Automatic categorisation of log entries

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2+ (or any JetBrains IDE build 232+)
  • JDK 17+

Support

  • Issue Tracker
  • Documentation
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.3.1 — Production Release

  • Real Log Editor — Full table-based log viewer with colour-coded levels, keyword search, level filtering, and status bar
  • Working Settings — Configurable max lines, default filter level, line numbers, and auto-refresh
  • Pattern Extraction — Generate regex from selected text with UUID, timestamp, and IP recognition
  • Correlation Tracking — Search and track correlation IDs across log entries with duration and error reporting
  • Advanced Search — Regex, fuzzy (Levenshtein), and simple search modes (Premium)
  • Log Indexing — Multi-threaded log file indexing for fast lookups (Premium)
  • ML Classification — Statistical anomaly detection and pattern discovery (Premium)
  • Feedback System — Non-intrusive feedback prompt after 7 days of usage
  • Code Quality — 100% test coverage, full KDoc documentation, zero detekt violations
